india_context.procedural_notes: Processing children's data (individuals under 18 years) carries strict prohibitions against tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising under Section 9 of DPDPA 2023.
india_context.transitional_notes: Consent must be free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous with clear notice in all 22 Eighth Schedule languages.
verification_requirements: Verify verifiable parental consent mechanism for minors.
